Upload the vendor's countersigned commercial schedule containing the 20% holdback requirement to the procurement repository.
Structure cash disbursements so that no more than $9,000,000 in actual cash outflows occurs before the end of the current fiscal year, with the remaining $3,000,000 funded after October 1.
Apply the 20% holdback on each implementation invoice per the vendor's commercial schedule, releasing retained amounts only upon final acceptance.
